principle: HOLD may block one effect edge but MUST NOT globally block unrelated repository progress.

required_behavior.authority_missing: Persist REQUEST_AUTHORITY for the exact subject; do not block unrelated subjects.
required_behavior.api_unavailable: Persist bounded REOBSERVE intent; do not blind-retry; preserve prior exact evidence.
required_behavior.writer_active: Exactly one writer owns the exact subject slot; contenders deduplicate to HOLD/NOOP.
required_behavior.publication_authority_missing: Block only the publication edge, not repository-wide progress.
required_behavior.terminal: Remove or acknowledge the work unit so it cannot retain queue ownership.
